meta.name: caveman
meta.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Cuts output tokens 65% (measured) by speaking like caveman while keeping full technical accuracy. Supports intensity levels: lite, full (default), ultra, wenyan-lite, wenyan-full, wenyan-ultra. Use when user says "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "use caveman", "less tokens", "be brief", or invokes /caveman. Also auto-triggers when token efficiency is requested.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用原始人短句回复,省 token 且不失准确。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你希望模型的回答更简短,又不丢技术细节。
copy.tagline_en: Cut replies to caveman-style brevity, saving tokens while keeping accuracy.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want shorter model replies without losing technical detail.

howto.what: 开启后 Claude 改用极简短句回复，去掉冠词、套话与修饰词，只保留技术要点，输出 token 约少 65%（实测）。全程保持此风格，直到你要求恢复。
howto.when: 当你说出“caveman mode”、“use caveman”等关键词，或要求精简输出、节省 token 时触发；也可用 /caveman 命令启动。风格持续整个会话，直到你说停止。

say.text: 进入 caveman mode，所有回复都用极简短句
say.note: 开启后回复会变得短而准。

say.text: 用 ultra 强度，把输出压到最短
这段话改成 wenyan-full 文言文风格

howto.what_en: Caveman mode makes Claude reply in terse, fragmented sentences. It strips articles, fillers, and pleasantries, keeping only technical substance. Output tokens drop ~65% (measured), and the style persists for the whole session until told to stop.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'caveman mode', 'use caveman', 'less tokens', etc., or ask for token-efficient output. Also activated via /caveman command. Style persists until you say stop.

say_en.text: Enter caveman mode and keep all replies terse.
Use ultra intensity, compress the output as much as possible.
Rewrite this explanation in wenyan-full classical Chinese.
